settled_invariants: Mesh is the common canonical domain for mechanics and appearance.
CAA is total over every renderable surface state and may not mutate canonical geometry.
Qualified source appearance is immutable; source wins over completion.
Presentation warp is forbidden in CAA V1.
Internal appearance filtering/compositing is premultiplied alpha with canonical bleed.
Runtime performs no generative or corrective appearance inference.
MechanicalPartition UNKNOWN stays conservative in first V2; dynamic failure may repair only through a new Stage18 lineage.
Downstream failure cannot erase verified independent upstream PASS.
First Knight V2 retains exact 8 controlled source views only to isolate architecture change; this does not assert 8 inputs are a permanent product requirement.
Product closure is Stage46 and requires native dynamic visual integrity.

continuation_protocol.experiment_completion_definition: A stage closes only when its ledger row is PASS/CACHE_HIT, exact output hashes verify, and the next stage consumes those exact bindings. Stage46 alone may close PRODUCT_PASS.
